description: D_new — hand-curated edge cases for WCAG 2.4 focus-behavior repair benchmarks. Cases are deliberately broken to test repair effectiveness across patterns not well-represented in D_d.

cases.rationale: Real-world pattern: modal close button rendered below translucent backdrop due to z-index mistake.
cases.notes: Verifier should detect obscuration; fix should raise modal z-index above backdrop.

cases.rationale: Common anti-pattern: outline:none with subtle border-color change as sole focus indicator.
cases.notes: Width and contrast both below AAA minima.

cases.rationale: Positive tabindex inserts nav link out of natural order. NOTE: SC 2.4.3 dropped from project scope; case retained for completeness.
